clusterElements.name: jevDocumentFilter
clusterElements.description: Screens every retrieved passage against the question with Jev before it reaches the prompt. Passages that carry a prompt injection, are not relevant or hold no answering evidence are dropped; passages that contradict the question's premise are kept and tagged CONFLICTING. Each passage costs one Jev call, so place the filter before a reranker.

properties.description: ID of the Jev model to use, e.g. `jev-latest`, `jev-preview` or a pinned version such as `jev-1.13.0`.
properties.label: Model
properties.name: model

properties.description: A passage whose prompt-injection value is above this is dropped.
properties.label: Injection Threshold
properties.name: injectionThreshold

properties.description: A passage whose contradicts-the-premise value is above this is kept and tagged CONFLICTING.
properties.label: Contradiction Threshold
properties.name: contradictionThreshold

properties.description: A passage whose relevance value is below this is dropped.
properties.label: Relevance Threshold
properties.name: relevanceThreshold

properties.description: A passage is kept only when its answer-evidence value is above this.
properties.label: Evidence Threshold
properties.name: evidenceThreshold

properties.description: The number of Jev calls made at the same time, one per passage.
properties.label: Concurrency
properties.name: concurrency
